Calculation.Text: /* fmIDE.FmpUrlFromThingamajig ( protocol_default ; server_address_default ; fmide_thingamajig_uri ) Magically converts the fmIDE_thingamjig_uri to an fmp url for fmIDE. @param protocol_default (text) - The default fmp/claris protocol to use if none is specified in the thigamajig url @param server_address_default (text) - The default server address to use if none is specified in the thigamajig url @param fmIDE_thingamjig_uri (text) - the fmIDE_thingamajig_uri uri defining a resource in a FileMaker database. See https://github.com/fmIDE/fmIDE/wiki/fmIDE-Thingamajig-URIs-and-the-magical-URIcorn-%F0%9F%A6%84 20221005 MrW v0.2 Added support for fmp19 and Claris Pro and standardised parameter names 20220927 MrW v0.1 */ Let ( [ ¢thingamajig = fmIDE_thingamajig_uri ; ¢application_version = +GetValue( Substitute( Get ( ApplicationVersion ) ; "." ; "¶" ) ; 1 ) ; ¢pos = Position( ¢thingamajig & "&" ; "&" ; 1 ; 1 ) ; ¢fmide_parameters = Right( ¢thingamajig ; Length( ¢thingamajig )+1 - ¢pos ) ; ¢fmide_file_uri_path = Left( ¢thingamajig ; ¢pos-1) ; ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bits = Substitute ( ¢fmide_file_uri_path ; "/" ; "¶" ) ; ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count = ValueCount ( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bits ) ; ¢fmide_file_name = Case( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count ≥ 1 ; GetValue ( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bits ; ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count ) ) ; ¢fmide_server = Case( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count ≥ 2 ; GetValue ( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bits ; ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count-1 ) ) ; ¢fmide_server = Case( not IsEmpty( ¢fmide_server ) ; ¢fmide_server ; not IsEmpty( server_address_default ) ; server_address_default ; "$" ) ; ¢fmide_protocol = Case( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count ≥ 3 ; GetValue ( ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bits ; ¢fmide_file_uri_path_bit_count-2 ) ) ; ¢fmide_protocol = Case( /* Protocol from thingamajig */ not IsEmpty( ¢fmide_protocol ) ; ¢fmide_protocol ; /* Protocol from parameter */ not IsEmpty( protocol_default ) ; protocol_default ; /* Otherwise use the protocol of the current application */ ¢application_version < 19 ; "fmp" ; ¢application_version < 40 ; "fmp" & ¢application_version ; "claris" ) ]; Case ( not IsEmpty ( ¢fmide_file_name ) ; ¢fmide_protocol & "://" & ¢fmide_server & "/" & ¢fmide_file_name & "?script=fmIDE" & ¢fmide_parameters ) )
